notes.title: 🎮 Get ready to smurf with the Demo version of The Smurfs - Dreams 💭
notes.notes:
Hello Smurfs in the making,

Discover Chef Smurf’s and Vanity Smurf’s dreams (or nightmares…?) in the Demo version of The Smurfs - Dreams, available on October 24th!

[previewyoutube=oKPE9BsBs7o;full][/previewyoutube]

Gargamel has devised a new evil scheme to catch the Smurfs! He casted a cunning curse on the sarsaparilla bushes, causing a deep slumber across the Smurfs after they eat the delicious leaves.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925924/ce63641eb3b68117f7290a5e80f408460ee754ef.jpg

Alone or with a friend, discover enchanting locations and explore the dreams of your favorite Smurfs. Each dream is a unique adventure, with smurfingly exciting challenges and mind-boggling puzzles. Imagination comes to life in this fully immersive and magical 3D platformer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925924/c196371ec0707588014f695952f93a565baabe0a.png

Ready to jump into dreamlike action?

💭 Play the Demo for The Smurfs - Dreams now
